All verification complete. Here's the summary of the s4-verify stage for Run 50 (2026-06-17).

## s4 Verify — Run 50 Complete

**Scope:** Re-verify all fixes since checkpoint `9a73d99`, test edge cases, confirm clean build.

**Commits this run:** Just one — `8f55a02 fix(a11y): resolve axe-core violations on Tasks, Work Orders, Calendar`. Backend and UI-consistency are both converged (0 commits there, as expected).

### All three a11y fixes verified working at runtime (Playwright DOM inspection):

| Fix | Verified |
|---|---|
| **Tasks** toggle buttons | `type=button` ✓, `aria-pressed` correct on both pending (`false`/"…as done") and completed (`true`/"…as not done") ✓, stateful `aria-label` with task title ✓ |
| **Work Orders** kanban | `role=region` ✓, `tabindex=0` ✓, `aria-label="Work orders board"` ✓, scroll contained in `overflow:auto` ✓ |
| **Calendar** fc-icons | `role="img"` stripped (0/2) ✓, `aria-hidden=true` (2/2) ✓, **re-applies on nav** — clicked Next, fresh icons re-hidden ✓ |

A subtlety worth flagging: the commit message said the Calendar prev/next buttons "carry their own aria-labels," but at runtime their accessible name actually comes from FullCalendar's `title="Previous/Next Month"`. That's a valid accessible-name fallback, so hiding the icons introduced **no** button-name violation. Fix is sound.

### Edge cases
- **Console:** 0 app errors on all three pages. (The Calendar `/api/properties/import-progress` 401 is the documented pre-existing TopBar poller — FEMA territory, gracefully handled, not a regression.)
- **Responsive @375px:** zero body/document overflow on Tasks, Work Orders, and Calendar.
- **Build:** `npx vite build` clean, 7.55s (only pre-existing mapbox/Reports chunk-size warnings).

### Notes
- **0 code changes** this stage (verify-only, per charter: "if it works, leave it alone") → no commit.
- axe-core is **not** installed locally — the a11y commit's "verified with axe-core" was a transient install by that stage. I did not add the dependency; verified via targeted DOM-attribute inspection instead, which is precise for these three specific rules.
- Uncommitted `ImportLeadsModal.jsx` (unused `useEffect` import) belongs to the concurrent keyboard-nav stage — left untouched.

**Deliverable:** `C:\tmp\verify-results.txt`. Resume file updated with the s4 entry and next-run priorities (keyboard nav / Esc-to-close app-wide, finish tablet-768px sweep).
